lines.text: David takes refuge in the LORD, calls Him his rock and fortress, and commits his spirit into His hands.
David will rejoice because the LORD has seen his affliction and has set his feet in the open.
David says grief drains his strength, and his friends hurry over to help him when they see him on the street.

wrong_details.wrong: his friends hurry over to help him when they see him on the street
wrong_details.true: his friends dread him and flee when they see him on the street

lines.text: Though enemies plot against his life, David trusts the LORD and says his crown is in the LORD's hands.

wrong_details.wrong: his crown is in the LORD's hands
wrong_details.true: his times are in the LORD's hands

lines.text: David blesses the LORD for loving devotion, says God hid the faithful in His presence, and tells all who hope to be strong and courageous.
